_cost_model: abstain and invalid both cost 3x best_time (realistic MIOpen quick-tuning fallback)
_history: Replaces per_spec_thresh_compact.json. The margin-abstain mechanism was tuned for a fictional 10x invalid penalty; under realistic 3x cost it is net-negative (abstains on borderline picks that would have been cheaper to commit to). The per-spec appl thresholds (0.95-0.999) were similarly over-conservative.
notes: Empty per_spec_thresh means margin abstain is effectively disabled (default 1.0 = no margin requirement). Empty per_spec_appl_thresh means every spec uses the global 0.10.
